documents.title: Orthopedic clinic visit
documents.author: S. Rehman (Orthopedics)
documents.text:
Chief complaint: chronic right knee pain for 4 months after a fall while playing cricket.
History: Difficulty kneeling and climbing stairs, and pain wakes him at night. No locking reported.
Examination: Mild effusion, tenderness over the medial joint line, and a positive McMurray test.
Assessment: Chronic right knee pain, suspected medial meniscal tear.
Plan: Request MRI of the right knee without contrast.

documents.title: Physiotherapy progress note
documents.author: Physiotherapy department
documents.text:
Referral: right knee pain after sports injury.
Completed 4 weeks of physiotherapy with minimal relief.
Home exercise program reviewed and continued.

documents.title: X-ray report, right knee
documents.author: Radiology department
documents.text:
Examination: X-ray of the right knee on 02 Aug 2026, standing AP and lateral views.
Findings: Joint spaces preserved. No fracture.
Impression: Normal radiograph of the right knee.

attachable_documents.title: Physiotherapy discharge summary (updated)
attachable_documents.author: Physiotherapy department
attachable_documents.text:
Physiotherapy continued after the progress note of 05 Sep 2026.
Completed 6 weeks of physiotherapy (05 Aug to 16 Sep 2026) with minimal relief.
Persistent pain on stairs and kneeling despite good adherence.
